meta.description: Registry for bounded branch-growth and pruning-threshold conditions in Phase 3.

branch_explosion_limit_entries.name: Branch Explosion Limits
branch_explosion_limit_entries.purpose: Represent bounded branch-growth and admissibility-preserving pruning behavior across recursive continuation structures.

branch_limit_conditions.name: branch_growth_remains_detectable
branch_limit_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to detect when the number of concurrent branches exceeds expected stability bounds.

branch_limit_conditions.name: bounded_pruning_thresholds_defined
branch_limit_conditions.description: Pruning rules must operate with finite, non-zero thresholds to prevent both explosion and total witness loss.

branch_limit_conditions.name: multi_branch_retention_preserved
branch_limit_conditions.description: Pruning must not force unique continuation where multi-valued actualization is structurally required.

branch_limit_conditions.name: pruning_does_not_force_unique_continuation
branch_limit_conditions.description: Limiting branch growth does not bypass the fundamental non-determinism of the delta operator.

branch_limit_conditions.name: orientation_sensitive_pruning_remains_bounded
branch_limit_conditions.description: Directional pruning must not result in unrecoverable frame bias or basin escape.

branch_limit_conditions.name: recursive_branch_updates_remain_admissible
branch_limit_conditions.description: Each step of branch scaling and reduction must satisfy current process admissibility windows.

branch_limit_conditions.name: transport_flux_does_not_force_branch_divergence
branch_limit_conditions.description: Nonlocal influence propagation must not result in an unconstrained explosion of realized continuation events.

branch_limit_conditions.name: branch_explosion_detection_conditions_defined
branch_limit_conditions.description: Explicit criteria for identifying runaway branch growth must be established and registered.
